title: Share an incident
description: Text reports, voice input, and transcript review are being developed. This preview does not collect or submit incidents.
nextDescription: You will be able to review and edit a transcript before choosing to submit a report.

describe.title: What happened?
describe.subtitle: Share what you experienced or saw. You can write in English, සිංහල, தமிழ், or a mix.
describe.placeholder: Describe the incident in your own words
describe.transcriptBody: Voice transcripts can contain mistakes. Read and edit the text above before you continue.
describe.transcriptNeeded: Please confirm the transcript to continue.
describe.tooLong: Your text is over {{max}} characters. Edit it before continuing; nothing has been truncated.

voice.title: Voice input
voice.demoNote: Demo: no audio is recorded. A sample transcript is used until the speech service is connected.
voice.idle: Tap start, then describe what happened.
voice.error: We couldn't transcribe that. Try again, or type instead.
voice.recordingNote: Record up to {{max}} seconds. After stopping, choose Transcribe to send the audio securely to the backend. Review and edit the returned text before submitting a report. Closing this dialog discards the recording.

states.ready: Recording ready. Choose Transcribe, or record again.
states.error: Recording or transcription could not be completed.

errors.unsupported: Recording needs a supported browser with microphone and AudioWorklet access. Use HTTPS or localhost, or type your report instead.
errors.denied: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in your browser and device settings, then try recording again, or type instead.
errors.device: No available microphone was found. Check that it is connected and not blocked by another app.
errors.empty: The recording was empty or silent. Record again and speak near the microphone.
errors.capture: Recording could not be completed. Check your microphone and try again, or type instead.
errors.tooLarge: The backend rejected the recording size or duration. Record a shorter clip.
errors.format: The backend rejected the audio format. Record again, or type your report instead.
errors.noSpeech: The backend could not use this recording or find usable speech. Record again, or retry transcription manually.
errors.unavailable: Transcription is temporarily unavailable. Wait and retry manually, or type your report.
errors.auth: Log in to a real account before recording or retrying transcription. Logging in again discards this recording; your existing report text is preserved.
errors.configuration: Set VITE_API_BASE_URL and the public Supabase configuration locally, then restart the development server.
errors.network: Transcription could not be reached or timed out. Check your connection and retry manually while this dialog remains open.
errors.generic: Transcription could not be completed. Retry manually, record again, or type your report.

when.title: When and where?
when.subtitle: Time, date and location are all optional.
when.whenLabel: What time of day did it happen?
when.whereHint: Only an approximate area is used, never your exact spot.
when.denied: Location permission is off. You can choose a district instead.
when.unavailable: We couldn't get your location. You can choose a district instead.
when.occurredAtHint: If you know the date and time, enter them separately from the time of day. Your device’s time zone is used.

details.title: Anything else?
details.subtitle: Optional. Skip anything you're not sure about.

lightingOptions.UNKNOWN_OR_PREFER_NOT_TO_SAY: Not sure / prefer not to say

review.title: Review and submit
review.subtitle: Check your report before you send it.
review.privacy: Your description stays private. The public map only shows an approximate area and report counts.
review.aiNote: AI will suggest a category and seriousness. These are estimates and can be wrong.
review.errorBody: Your report is still on this device. Please try again.
review.invalid: Enter a description of 1–5,000 characters (not just spaces) and check any optional date and time.
review.authError: Your session is missing, expired, or was rejected. Log in again to submit. Your report draft is preserved.
review.forbidden: This account is not allowed to submit the report. Your draft is preserved.
review.validationError: The report fields were rejected. Review your description and optional answers; your draft is preserved.
review.rateLimit: Too many report submissions. Please wait before trying again. Your draft is preserved.
review.networkError: Report creation could not be confirmed. Check your connection and whether it was saved before retrying. Your draft is preserved.
review.configurationError: Report submission is not configured correctly. Check VITE_API_BASE_URL and the public Supabase configuration, then restart the development server.
review.confirmationError: The backend confirmed report creation, but the saved details could not be read. Do not submit again. Your text is still available here.

submitted.title: Report received
submitted.subtitle: Thank you for sharing this.
submitted.next: Before a report appears on the map it may be checked for duplicates or unusual patterns. That is not a judgement about you.
submitted.empty: There is no report to show.
submitted.saved: Your report was saved. This confirms report creation, not the outcome of automatic AI analysis.
